aphis:epermits.name: 93-120-18n — Potato (North Dakota State University)
aphis:epermits.desc: Notification to release genetically engineered potato at 2 declared locations in ID, ND. Applicant: North Dakota State University. Status: Acknowledged. Declared traits: product quality. The applicant claimed confidential business information on this record, so the trait description is partly withheld as [CBI] in the source. The dot is scattered inside the state, not placed at a site: APHIS publishes the state and the number of release locations, never the locations themselves. Australia is the only regulator in the world that publishes field trial sites. Position is a state centroid, not the site — APHIS publishes release states, never coordinates.
